question: The Kodaikanal Solar Observatory (KSO), which completed 125 years in 2024, is located in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Kodaikanal Solar Observatory (KSO)** is a premier solar physics research facility located in the **Palani Hills** of **Tamil Nadu**, **India**.
 
• In **2024**, the observatory celebrated its **125th anniversary**, having been officially established on **April 1, 1899**.
 
• It is owned and operated by the **Indian Institute of Astrophysics (IIA)**, which is an autonomous research institute under the **Department of Science and Technology**, Government of India.
 
• The site was chosen in the late **19th century** due to its high altitude of approximately **2,343 meters** and its stable atmospheric conditions, which are ideal for **solar observations**.
